journey.name: subscription cancellation during confirmation
journey.description: Requires a linked regtest issuer and a payer funded for two 5,000-sat on-chain payments. The issuer can cancel an accepted recurring request with a fixed P2WPKH endpoint and no payment deadline. Verifies cancellation while confirmation is open. The first period is paid by the acceptance swipe itself, so the open confirmation is reached on the next period by advancing the subscription clock offset. Cancellation after payment preparation or during an authorization lookup is covered by unit tests.

actions.action: Have the issuer propose a monthly subscription for 5,000 sats with no payment deadline and an explicit regtest P2WPKH endpoint
Accept the proposal in Bitkit and wait for the first period's payment to send and the Subscribed confirmation to appear, then close it
Advance the subscription clock offset to the next monthly period in Dev Settings, then refresh Subscriptions
Open the next unpaid period to the send confirmation screen without confirming payment
Have the issuer cancel the subscription and keep Bitkit foregrounded until the payer's request state or logs confirm receipt of the cancellation
If the send confirmation is still open, try to confirm payment and verify it is refused
Verify no transaction for that period was broadcast to the request's receiving address and no payment proof was created for the period
Return to Subscriptions and verify the canceled subscription offers no action to pay its unpaid period
Reset the subscription clock offset in Dev Settings
